items.heading: Being Called Professional Has
items.text: Being called professional has to mean more than a job title. The counsellor working your session is matched to the actual decision on the table, a stream choice, a stay-vs-pivot fork, an offer evaluation, instead of a single generalist handling every kind of question the same way.
